draft.text: You came in because you have had left shoulder pain for about three weeks.
The pain is constant and gets worse when you move or press on your shoulder.
You said the pain feels like a dull ache but becomes sharper with movement or pressure.
You have been having trouble with everyday tasks because of the pain.
You have been taking Tylenol to help with the pain.
You mentioned you have been doing a lot of work in the basement lately.
The cause of your pain is not clear yet.
The doctor thinks the pain might be related to the work you have been doing in the basement.
The doctor will order an X-ray of your left shoulder to look for any problems.
You will have a follow-up appointment to talk about the X-ray results and next steps.
